artworks.title: Vue prise dans la salle des pas perdus ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a corridor setting. The figures are depicted in a cartoonish manner, with exaggerated facial features and postures. They stand or walk with hunched backs and elongated heads, engaging in various expressions. The scene is detailed with shading, capturing a sense of depth and providing a lively yet somber atmosphere. The drawing appears to be done using soft pencil or charcoal.

artworks.title: Le triomphe de la loi du 31 Mai
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatured figures carrying a larger figure labeled "LOI DU 31 MAI" on its hat. The dominant figure being carried is oversized, with a protruding belly and a disgruntled expression. The figures beneath are exaggerated in their features and are hunched under the weight. They are dressed in formal or government attire. This image uses satire to comment on the perceived difficulty of maintaining a specific law or decree, evident from the expressions of the carrying figures.

artworks.title: Athalie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing close together. The person on the left has a beard and curly hair, looking surprised. The middle individual has a hood and short dark hair, looking dramatic with raised hands. The person on the right has a bald head, long facial hair, and a surprised expression. All three wear loose, robe-like garments. The background is dark and neutral.

artworks.title: Comment ... tu as encore acheté un ... chapeau ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a couple interacting in a room. The drawing features two figures, one dressed in a cloak and bonnet gesturing towards the other, who is holding a top hat and a newspaper or document. The scene is accompanied by text above and below it, headlined "SCÈNES CONJUGALES." The interior setting is suggested by subtle lines indicating a doorway or frame in the background. This composition captures a moment of domestic discourse, characterized by detailed attire and expressive posture, with shading and line work emphasizing the folds of the clothing and the contours of the figures. The style suggests a narrative.

artworks.title: J'veux pas entrer dans tant d'eau ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a child on the edge of a bath, with a figure behind them. The child's feet create ripples in the water below. The figure seems to be supporting or encouraging the child. The room is simply furnished, with a hat hanging in the background and water dripping from the tub. There is a caption in French implying the child's concern about large fish in the water.

artworks.title: Une promenade conjugale
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In this illustration, there are two people, a man and a woman. The man is on the right, standing slightly forward with his left leg extended and holding a cane with his right hand. The woman is walking beside him on his left. The man has distinctive facial features, a wavy hairstyle, and is dressed in a formal suit with a top hat. The woman has a gentle expression, soft waves or a bonnet in her hair, and wears a long dress, possibly with a shawl. The background shows rocky terrain, a tree, and some suggestive landscape outlines.

artworks.title: Ayant une discussion a propos de leur beauté
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three full-bodied figures are shown in a dramatic scene. Two women stand on either side of a man. One woman on the left is holding onto the man's shoulders, while the woman on the right has her hands raised. Both women have curly hair and wide-eyed facial expressions. The woman on the left wears a dark dress, and the woman on the right wears a striped gown. The man in the center is leaning forward, wearing a dark suit and a hat, seemingly moving towards the woman on the left. The setting is indoors, with large drapes and a folding screen behind them.

artworks.title: Tiens! Moi, croyais avoir tué un lapin! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene. It depicts a hunter leaning towards a dog holding a large animal in its mouth. The hunter wears rustic attire and carries a shotgun. In the background, another figure gestures, with hints of a rural setting. The drawing has a humorous tone, emphasizing the size of the animal brought by the dog.

artworks.title: Un comité écoutant la lecture d'une tragédie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The drawing shows a group of people from the waist up sitting around a table. There is a range of expressions among them. The person on the far left has a receding hairline and looks forward. Next to him is a man with facial sideburns looking down, holding a piece of paper. Two middle-aged men appear slightly startled. Beside them, a man with unkempt hair, a beard, and an expressive face gestures dramatically with his hand extended forward. The individuals wear formal dark suits typical of the era. The room has simple decor with a table holding a book and papers. The background suggests a wall in a simple interior space.

artworks.title: Quand des femmes savent avoir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features two women in long dresses and bonnets engaged in conversation on a cobbled street. They have distinct facial features and one woman gestures with her hand. In the background are outlines of buildings, abstract architectural details, and a tree to the right. The setting appears to be urban. Text is located under the image.

artworks.title: Un affeux trio
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three men playing musical instruments. The man on the left plays the violin, the middle man plays the flute, and the right man plays the piano. The men are partially shown from at least the waist up in an indoor setting with a plain background. The men wear formal attire.

artworks.title: Recevant la férule
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated on a bench or chair, leaning forward with both hands extended towards a hand holding a wooden paddle. The person has exaggerated facial features, wears a tall hat with text and folded paper, and is dressed in a coat with visible stockings and shoes. A large bag rests on their lap. The background has a textured gradient and glowing rays surrounding the paddle. The setting appears editorial with text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: L'ennemi des chiens ayant eu l'imprudence ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. The image shows a man being chased by a group of women and a dog. The man looks startled as he runs away from them, while the women are depicted in pursuit. One of the women is holding a dog and seems to be leading the chase. The dog is facing a different direction. The drawing is done in black and white with bold lines and shading to create depth and movement. The characters have exaggerated expressions and poses, conveying a sense of urgency and humor. The background suggests a simple street setting with basic architectural elements. The style of the drawing is humorous and caricatured, resembling works by Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Nouveau manteau talma
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of two men facing each other. The man on the left is in profile with a long face, pointed nose, and chin, curly hair under his hat. The man on the right looks ahead with a wide smile, broad face, and curly hair under his hat. Both wear top hats, capes, and wide collars. The man on the right is holding his cape's edge. In the background, faintly sketched figures wearing similar attire are visible, with one man's face partially shown. The setting is a plain background, suggesting a public or street scene. The title "Les Parisiens en 1852" indicates it is depicting Parisians in 1852.

artworks.title: Un jour  de représentation a benéfice
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two individuals stand side by side in a three-quarter view from the waist up. They have elongated facial features with pronounced noses and are smiling. Both wear tall top hats, dark suits, and hold canes. In the background are a few other figures and a round window with writing near it. The backdrop is a lightly sketched, textured wall. The words "LES PARISIENS EN 1852" are printed at the top.

artworks.title: A la santé du raisin! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men engaged in a toast. The man on the left is fully visible from head to toe, standing with one arm extended, holding a glass. He has short, curly hair and a distinctive facial expression with his mouth open. He wears a dark jacket over a light shirt, and dark pants. The man on the right is shown from a side angle and is partially obscured, slouched over a wooden table while holding his own glass. His hair is also dark and curly, but his face is not visible. He is dressed in a shirt and plaid pants. On the table between them, a pitcher is visible. The background has a simple, lightly shaded design, possibly outdoors, with a faint horizon and a blossomed tree or bush depicted. Text at the top reads "CROQUIS VARIÉS," and there is more text at the bottom as a caption for the illustration.

artworks.title: Voila des gens ont une ... fichue maniére ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature illustration of three men walking together. Their exaggerated facial features typical of caricature are visible. The man on the left wears a top hat and holds a rifle. The middle man is shorter with a round hat and bushy mustache, also carrying a rifle. The man on the right has curly hair under a top hat and a formal coat, with one hand resting on a walking stick. The background is simple, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Il faut me trouver ... trois pièces ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a conversation or inspection inside a room. The figure on the left is hunched, wearing a hat and holding an object, while the figure on the right stands upright with a long face, leaning on a cane. The scene has sketchy shading and no visible decoration. The figures have exaggerated features and poses. The text at the bottom is in French, referencing 'Locataires et Propriétaires' (tenants and landlords).

artworks.title: Un rendez vous, c'est peut-être de la...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a hunched posture, facing the right side. They wear a nightcap and round spectacles, have a prominent nose and short hair, and wear a long shirt and appear to have bare legs. They hold a letter or piece of paper, looking intently at it. The surroundings include a piece of furniture draped with a blanket or cloth, and a cylindrical table. The background has shading suggesting a dimly lit or sketch-like interior setting.

artworks.title: Le jeudi
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a group of people portrayed in pencil outside an exhibition entrance. A man stands facing the entrance, wearing a long coat and a top hat. A woman stands beside him, wearing a dark dress with a scarf tied over her hair. A man inside the entrance wears a dark coat and a hat. A child in a cap and coat is partially visible, holding hands with the man in the top hat. The background shows signage reading "EXPOSITION" and "ENTRÉE 3 FRANCS," against a backdrop of architectural elements.

artworks.title: Bertrand, voila des gaillards ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two exaggerated figures observing a large group in the distance. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier. The drawing features two prominent figures in the left foreground dressed in 19th-century attire. Their expressions are exaggerated and comically rendered, typical of caricatures. One figure gestures animatedly, possibly addressing the multitude below, while the other stands in a more subdued posture. The background is composed of a large gathering of individuals, depicted with simple lines suggesting a mass of bodies. The scene is dynamic and captures a moment of speech or proclamation. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing shading techniques to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: L'ours du nord, le plus désagréable de tous les ours connus
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bear wearing a crown and holding a scepter and sword. The bear is standing upright, with its left arm raised high holding a torch and its right arm holding a sword. In the background, a group of smaller, indistinct figures appear to be bowing or kneeling. The use of shading with pencil or charcoal offers a contrast, highlighting the central figure. The drawing conveys themes of dominance and authority.

artworks.title: Entre deux fauteuils le ...monsieur par terre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a figure seated between two ornate chairs labeled "BYZANCE" and "GRECE," each adorned with a crown symbol. The person-like figure sits on the floor, wearing tattered clothing and looking perplexed or distressed. The background has a textured surface resembling a newspaper page, suggesting a satirical or editorial illustration quality.

artworks.title: Ayant enfin trouvé le moyen d'ultiliser leurs loisirs!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a nautical setting. The figures are sitting with exaggerated features, holding sticks. The central figure is dressed in a military uniform with a large plumed hat, while the other two wear large hats and loose clothing. The background suggests a nautical theme with ropes and ship elements. The drawing uses bold lines and shading to highlight clothing textures and whimsical features of the subjects.
